I'm trying to recurse through my photo archive to try to find duplicates. For each file, I send FullName to get-filehash. I get a LOT of these errors, which implies a permissions issues, but after finding this pull request, I see that it is working as expected. 
Error:
`Get-FileHash: Access to the path 'E:\PHOTO\Lightroom CC Library\Lightroom CC\684f1da3ca494b3e854964d66fd6f341\originals\2011\2011-12-22' is denied.`

Invocation:
`Get-ChildItem -Recurse -path E:\PHOTO\ | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName | Get-FileHash | Export-Csv -Append h:\photo_hash_list3.csv`

You can add the `-File` param to your Get-ChildItem call to avoid the issue entirely.

issue_context.title: Get-FileHash access denied
issue_context.body:
When using PS 7 preview 5 Get-FileHash it returns access denied to path from pipe

ex. 
```
Get-ChildItem -path "C:\Program Files\" -Recurse | Get-FileHash
Get-FileHash: Access to the path 'C:\Program Files\Common Files' is denied.

From Windows PS
Get-ChildItem -path "C:\Program Files\" -Recurse | Get-FileHash
Algorithm       Hash                                                                   Path
---------       ----
```
comments:
Looks like this happens in `Get-FileHash`:

```
> Get-Error

Exception             :
    TargetSite :
        Name          : ValidateFileHandle
        DeclaringType : System.IO.FileStream
        MemberType    : Method
        Module        : System.Private.CoreLib.dll
    StackTrace :
   at System.IO.FileStream.ValidateFileHandle(SafeFileHandle fileHandle)
   at System.IO.FileStream.CreateFileOpenHandle(FileMode mode, FileShare share, FileOptions options)

FileOptions options)
```

I think we need to write non-terminating error for the pipeline scenario.

Is this part of PowerShell 7.0.0-rc.1?
Looks like it is still a problem.
@SteveL-MSFT Can we add the commit to RC branch?

:tada:This issue was addressed in #11114, which has now been successfully released as `v7.0.0-rc.2`.:tada:

review_comments:
Do you think it's worth doing a general catch or additional catches here as well? Looking at the exceptions that can be thrown from [`System.IO.File.OpenRead`](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/system.io.file.openread?view=netcore-3.0#exceptions) it seems likely we can run into the following exceptions somewhat commonly as well:

- `PathTooLongException`
- `IOException`

IOException combines  FileNotFoundException, DirectoryNotFoundException, and PathTooLongException.

I guess PathTooLongException will be raised above at path resolving time.

So nothing to do. :-)
